current_state_summary: NASA, FAA, FDOT, and Space Florida records expose the corridor's planning, licensing, environmental, and capital layers, while one displayed site-license date is unresolved and project delivery remains record-specific.
current_state: NASA's current master plan defines a multi-user infrastructure direction rather than a funded build.
FAA records show Launch Complex 46 licensed through July 2030.
The official Shuttle Landing Facility record still displays a January 2026 expiration date.
SLC-40 has a final environmental decision for an expanded action without every downstream license and operating result.
Part 450 is the common national operator-licensing framework, while FDOT and Space Florida supply state planning and capital rails.
